_comment: A basic book somebody wrote (design 4.2): short, flat, from common words, and the start of how the
grammar is taught -- structure is never a page, so a writer meets it here and learns it by reading (4.5).
Rarer than a linking book on purpose. A linking book is a way home and you want one early; this is a
lesson, and finding a second before you have understood the first is worth much less than finding
one at a time. What it says comes from `art/generation/basic_book.json`, so retuning is a datapack edit.
The advanced and unstable kinds are inject/advanced_book and inject/unstable_book, and the D'ni city's.
